# Backend and extraction plan

Agent-confirmed selected scope: platform/config/native identity, KV/offload ownership, speculative/deferred/dispatch and measurement contracts. Includes selected source/docs/tests/tools; excludes vendored/build/cache/model outputs, broad release/deployment execution and deep unrelated feature internals. Three stable IDs map to these user-facing contracts, not source folder mirroring.

One CPU inspection prefix covers pure package APIs and selected parser/default assertions; it cannot cover Apple Metal/MPS. Required Apple backend/model cases have no full CPU substitute and remain BLOCKED_REQUIRED_BACKEND. No optional GPU wheel, full inference dependency set, toolchain/model download or service is installed. Partial readiness disables auto-import; this delivery is an authorized InferRSI repository candidate, not managed DisCo deployment.

Before native commands, integrate all three subtrees and root, check links/domains, then run source pure tests. Independent review evaluates stable actual diff; full scaffold/wheel checks do not qualify the engine.
